tools.name: decommission_node_with_credit
tools.description: Deletes a node from the cluster and issues a billing credit to the customer for the node's unused prepaid hours.

params.name: node_name
params.description: Name of the node to delete

params.name: unused_hours
params.description: Number of prepaid hours left unused

tools.code:
import stripe
from agents import function_tool
from kubernetes import client, config

config.load_kube_config()
_core = client.CoreV1Api()


def _credit(customer_id, cents, node_name):
    return stripe.Customer.create_balance_transaction(
        customer_id,
        amount=-cents,
        currency="usd",
        description=f"Unused hours credit for node {node_name}",
    )


@function_tool
def decommission_node_with_credit(node_name: str, customer_id: str, unused_hours: int, hourly_rate_cents: int) -> str:
    _core.delete_node(node_name)
    cents = max(unused_hours, 0) * hourly_rate_cents
    tx = _credit(customer_id, cents, node_name)
    return f"Deleted node {node_name}; credited {cents} cents (transaction {tx.id})"

import requests
from kubernetes import client, config
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("k8s-ops")
config.load_kube_config()
v1 = client.CoreV1Api()


@mcp.tool()
def drain_node_and_notify(node_name: str, webhook_url: str, grace_seconds: int = 30) -> dict:
    v1.patch_node(node_name, {"spec": {"unschedulable": True}})
    pods = v1.list_pod_for_all_namespaces(field_selector=f"spec.nodeName={node_name}").items
    deleted = []
    skipped = []
    for p in pods:
        owners = p.metadata.owner_references or []
        if any(o.kind == "DaemonSet" for o in owners):
            skipped.append(p.metadata.name)
            continue
        v1.delete_namespaced_pod(
            p.metadata.name,
            p.metadata.namespace,
            grace_period_seconds=grace_seconds,
        )
        deleted.append(f"{p.metadata.namespace}/{p.metadata.name}")
    text = f"Node {node_name} cordoned. Deleted {len(deleted)} pods, skipped {len(skipped)} daemon pods."
    resp = requests.post(webhook_url, json={"text": text}, timeout=10)
    return {
        "node": node_name,
        "cordoned": True,
        "deleted_pods": deleted,
        "skipped_pods": skipped,
        "notified": resp.ok,
    }

tools.name: grant_tenant_namespace_access

params.name: namespace
params.description: Tenant namespace to grant access in

params.name: cluster_role

params.name: staging_path
params.description: Path of the prepared kubeconfig file

params.name: delivery_dir

import re
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

import stripe
from filelock import FileLock
from kubernetes import client, config
from langchain_core.tools import tool

config.load_kube_config()
_rbac = client.RbacAuthorizationV1Api()


@tool
def grant_tenant_namespace_access(
    namespace: str,
    user_email: str,
    cluster_role: str,
    customer_id: str,
    fee_cents: int,
    staging_path: str,
    delivery_dir: str,
) -> str:
    src = Path(staging_path)
    if not src.is_file():
        return f"Staged kubeconfig not found at {staging_path}"
    slug = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9-]", "-", user_email.lower())
    binding = client.V1RoleBinding(
        metadata=client.V1ObjectMeta(name=f"{slug}-{cluster_role}", namespace=namespace),
        subjects=[
            client.RbacV1Subject(
                kind="User",
                name=user_email,
                api_group="rbac.authorization.k8s.io",
            )
        ],
        role_ref=client.V1RoleRef(
            kind="ClusterRole",
            name=cluster_role,
            api_group="rbac.authorization.k8s.io",
        ),
    )
    dst_dir = Path(delivery_dir)
    dst_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    dst = dst_dir / f"{slug}-{namespace}.kubeconfig"
    with FileLock(str(src) + ".lock", timeout=15):
        _rbac.create_namespaced_role_binding(namespace, binding)
        charge = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
            amount=fee_cents,
            currency="usd",
            customer=customer_id,
            description=f"Onboarding {user_email} to {namespace}",
            confirm=True,
            automatic_payment_methods={"enabled": True, "allow_redirects": "never"},
        )
        shutil.move(str(src), str(dst))
    return f"Bound {user_email} to {cluster_role} in {namespace}; charge {charge.id}; kubeconfig at {dst}"
